toa-adventure-tracker.app.title: Wilderness Travel
toa-adventure-tracker.app.clearRollsHint: Clears every roll made today without touching the day counter.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.noParty: No travellers found. Check the "Traveller source" world option.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.lost: Lost! The party only covers half the distance.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.navPending: No navigation roll yet — showing the pace's full distance.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.coveredByRain: Rain and a rain catcher cover the water need. Anything foraged is a bonus.
toa-adventure-tracker.app.conSaveHint: CON saving throw due against DC
toa-adventure-tracker.moon.tooltip: Day {day} of {length} in the lunar cycle — {percent}% illuminated
toa-adventure-tracker.task.navigation.hi: Keeps the party on course. On a failure the party gets lost and covers only half the distance.
toa-adventure-tracker.task.water.label: Find water
toa-adventure-tracker.task.water.hint: On a success, 1d6 + WIS gallons of water.
toa-adventure-tracker.task.food.label: Forage
toa-adventure-tracker.task.food.hint: On a success, 1d6 + WIS pounds of food.
toa-adventure-tracker.confirm.completeDa: Complete day {day}? The day is written to the logbook, every roll is cleared and the counter advances.
toa-adventure-tracker.confirm.clearLog: Clear the entire logbook? This cannot be undone — export it first if you want to keep it.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.noGM: No GM connected — changes cannot be saved right now.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.badTaskJson: Custom tasks: invalid JSON ({error}). Falling back to the default list.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.noGroup: The configured group actor was not found. Using all player characters instead.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.badYield: The yield formula of task "{task}" could not be rolled.
toa-adventure-tracker.notify.emptyLog: The logbook is empty — nothing to export.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.cycleLeng: How many days a full lunar cycle takes. Default: 30.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.fullMoonD: Day of the first full moon
The travel day that is a full moon. Every other phase follows from it. Default: 1.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.slowMiles: Distance at a slow travel pace. Default: 9.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.slowMod.h: Modifier on the navigation roll at a slow pace. Default: +5.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.normalMil: Distance at a normal travel pace. Default: 10.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.normalMod: Modifier on the navigation roll at a normal pace. Default: 0.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.fastMiles: Distance at a fast travel pace. Default: 15.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.fastMod.h: Modifier on the navigation roll at a fast pace. Default: −5.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.usePaceRu: Also hands the travel pace to dnd5e so its own rules apply (advantage on Stealth while slow, disadvantage on Perception while fast). Independent of the modifier above.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.hexSize.h: Used only to convert the day's distance into hexes. Default: 10.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.partySour: Where the list of travellers comes from.
All characters with a player owner
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.groupActo: Name, id or uuid of the group actor. Used only when "A group actor" is selected above.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.customTas: A JSON array that extends or overrides the default list by id. Format documented in the README.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.travelers: 0 means: as many as the traveller source contains.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.rainColle: Together with the "It is raining today" switch this covers the water need automatically.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.conSaveDC: Shown in the notice when water is short. The module never rolls the save itself.
toa-adventure-tracker.settings.skipRollD: Rolls immediately, without dnd5e's configuration dialog. Applies to you only.
